# Generated code - do not edit by hand

| File | Produced by | When |
|---|---|---|
| `arity.zig` | `tools/gen_wrappers.zig` | when wrapper arities change |
| `manifest.zig` | `tools/scan.zig` | when exported functions change |

Both are **committed to version control** on purpose: a fresh checkout must build
with a plain `zig build`, without running the generators first. Regenerate with
`zig build gen` and commit the result in the same change as the source edit.
